Container.Name: immich-photo-manager
Container.Overview:
immich-photo-manager is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that brings rich photo library management, search, album creation, person/face querying, and PDF/archive exporting to AI agents (Claude, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Cursor, and any MCP client) via Streamable HTTP.
It exposes MCP endpoints on /mcp and liveness check on /health. Persistent exports and configuration are saved in /data.
Template maintained by repires; immich-photo-manager is developed by drolosoft (MIT).
Container.Requires: An active Immich server and an Immich API key created in Immich under Account Settings -> API Keys.

Config.Name: Port: MCP HTTP
Config.Description: HTTP port for MCP protocol (/mcp) and health check (/health).

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent directory for cached credentials, generated PDF books, and archive zip exports.

Config.Name: Immich Base URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Immich server. If attached to custom immich network, use http://immich_server:2283; on bridge network, use http://<UNRAID_IP>:8001.

Config.Name: Immich API Key
Config.Description: Immich API key with library permissions. Generate one in Immich: Account Settings -> API Keys.

Config.Name: MCP Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated Host header values allowed by the MCP server (DNS rebinding protection). Set to * or list all hostnames/IPs used to contact this service.

Config.Name: Cache & Config Directory
Config.Description: Path inside container where runtime MCP configuration and session credentials persist.
